theme_and_archetype.description: A high-end crypto trading bot interface. It balances futuristic neon energy (Archetype 7) with the sleek, reliable structure of luxury dark mode. Replaces generic 'SaaS purple' with a highly distinctive Electric Cyan and Hot Magenta pairing over deep obsidian/navy. Emphasizes liquid glass textures and neon circuit vibes.

typography.implementation_notes: Avoid Inter/Roboto completely. Use Unbounded for all numbers (prices, percentages, balances) to give them a premium 'ticker' feel. Ensure tabular-nums utility is used for live data.

spacing_and_layout.app_container: max-w-[480px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#050914] text-white relative shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] overflow-x-hidden pb-24
spacing_and_layout.safe_areas: Ensure content doesn't collide with the fixed bottom navigation (pb-24).

cards_glassmorphism.base_classes: bg-[#0F1524]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#00F0FF] text-[#050914] font-bold rounded-xl px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white transition-colors hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 text-white font-semibold border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/20
buttons.danger: bg-[#FF007A] text-white font-bold rounded-xl px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#FF007A]/80 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,0,122,0.6)]

bottom_navigation.container: fixed bottom-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full max-w-[480px] h-20 bg-[#050914]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 z-50 flex justify-around items-center px-2
bottom_navigation.item_inactive: text-[#8B9BB4] flex flex-col items-center gap-1 hover:text-white transition-colors

inputs.base: bg-[#050914] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00F0FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F0FF] transition-all placeholder:text-[#8B9BB4]

hero_banner.classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#00F0FF]/20 to-[#FF007A]/20 border border-white/10 p-6 flex flex-col justify-end min-h-[160px]

motion_and_interactions.testing_requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, nav items, tabs) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-bot-btn').

hero_background.description: Dynamic neon lines. Use as an absolute background image inside the promotional hero banner 'NEW ERA OF CRYPTO' with mix-blend-screen and opacity-40.

rewards_icon.description: Gold coins falling. Use this for the Rewards / Referral section header or banner to emphasize premium earnings.

texture_overlay.description: Network nodes. Use as a fixed background overlay on the entire app container with opacity-5 and mix-blend-overlay to add a cyber-texture.

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react. For active states or bot indicators, add a drop-shadow glow to the SVG.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic Shadcn components out-of-the-box. Customize their classes to match the 'cards_glassmorphism' and 'inputs' guidelines above.
The app MUST look like a mobile application. Enforce the max-w-[480px] container horizontally centered on larger screens with a dark background outside.
Implement the strategy configuration form densely but legibly, utilizing the 'overline_label' for input labels to save vertical space.
Add Framer Motion for staggered list rendering on the Trading Pairs feed and Transaction history.
Use 'Unbounded' for all metrics/numbers and 'Outfit' for readable text/descriptions.
CRITICAL: Include data-testid attributes on every interactive element (e.g., Buy, Sell, One-Shot, Settings, Nav links) to pass strict testing.
All backgrounds must be dark. Do not use white backgrounds for any surface.
